meta.notes: Seeded from devicePEQ by scripts/import/seed.ts. Values are what devicePEQ's handler encodes, not verified device limits. Every product id devicePEQ assigns to its "SchemeNo11" group, under each vendor id of the vendor block (0x0104, 0x011b, 0x011d, 0x0661, 0x0663, 0x0666, 0x0762, 0x0909, 0x0d8c, 0x2fc6, 0x3302, 0x34be, 0x35d8, 0x36a7, 0x373b, 0x60c1, 0x60e1, 0xb445, 0xb44d). devicePEQ doesn't record which vendor id goes with which product id, so most of these pairs don't exist. Replace with device profiles as devices are identified. The engine realizes 0.9775 × the frequency on the wire, so frequencies are multiples of 0.9775 Hz; the codec divides by 0.9775. devicePEQ configures nyquistScaledQ with a design rate of 96000 Hz, while its own comments derive about 49152 Hz from measurements. Unresolved upstream.
